description: Kredit is a UAE credit-card comparison platform that publishes card rankings, reward-rate datasets, and recommendation tooling. It helps users compare UAE credit cards and related financial products such as bank accounts.
summary: Kredit exposes two MCP endpoints on kredit.ae—an OAuth-discoverable streamable-HTTP MCP server at `/api/mcp/v2` and a catalog-listed SSE endpoint at `/api/mcp/sse`—plus several public JSON dataset endpoints under `/api/data` that the site explicitly says are public distributions rather than a supported developer API.
